_comment: PROPOSAL (Round 2 Part A, R2-D3). Not created in Shopify. Limits confirmed 2026-09-27 against shopify.dev (Metaobject limits; Metafield limits) and the Admin API (shop plan Basic; 32 existing definitions, 1 merchant-created; no 'sauna' type exists).

limits_checked.json_field_note: 128KB for JSON values; apps using JSON before 2026-04-01 grandfathered at 2MB. Largest record that meets the threshold is 19,893 bytes with offers, 19,513 without.
limits_checked.draft_visibility: publishable capability: DRAFT entries are not visible in storefronts (shopify.dev, Use metaobject capabilities)
limits_checked.online_store_url: /pages/{urlHandle}/{entry-handle}; template at templates/metaobject/{type}.json in the theme

fieldDefinitions.note: hub column; empty when not verified
the full record from saunas.json with `offers` removed (no price ever leaves the repo)
precomputed render strings: answer sentence, ask-the-seller questions, gate-passed snippets (<=160 chars), gap wording per field. Built by script, so Liquid does no logic that could invent a value
NAVIGATION ONLY (R2-D12), from inh-navigation.json; never inside `record`

product_side.note: Needed for the product-page link (a product cannot look up which metaobject names it). DECISION PENDING (Part A §7, D-E).
